title: Coordinated School Health Contact
before:
Emily Poland, MPH, RN, NCSN
School Nurse Consultant / Coordinated School Health Coordinator

Supports the following areas:

  • Guidance on statewide school health policies.
  • Information on Coordinated School Health Programs.
  • Expertise in school nursing practice and health service delivery.
  • Health policy development and support.
  • Direction in creating or improving a coordinated system of health services in schools.

Phone: 207-592-0387

Email: Emily.Poland@maine.gov

Sarah DeCato, MSN, RN, NCSN
School Nurse Specialist

Supports the following areas:

  • Guidance on infectious disease management and reportable conditions, early childcare and education, emergency planning for health, and immunization questions.
  • Student health issues related to communicable or infectious diseases.
  • Training and professional development.

notes: 433 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Let a lone card use the full width
decisions.why: 1 row holds a single card in a part-width column, so it takes a third or a half of the page and the rest is blank. A row of one is not a grid.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 9 email addresses sit in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.
